comparison.objective: Bag task opens a zipper, extracts one cell, and inserts it polarity-correct into a holder; candidate tunes and secures a damper through repeated test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Bag task tests slider pulling, extraction from a constrained opening, selective handling, orientation, and insertion. Candidate tests recessed tool seating, counterholding, fine collar rotation, relocking, and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Bag success requires ≥90% zipper travel, one lifted cell seated within 3 mm and 10°, the other retained, arms returned, and no cell loss. Candidate requires two compliant dynamic stops with no bottoming, hard-stop strike, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Selective extraction and polarity-sensitive insertion do not test dynamic damping adjustment. Missing rubric details: candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, and drift limits; bag versions differ in partial-credit weighting but not the full-success objective.
